lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Entrance Hall. Setup.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Make the front hall fit for a king again.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Small, cruel, personal.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Sets Grimm's character without a line of dialogue.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Freya's portrait has been turned to face the wall.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Pantry. First hard evidence.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Stock the pantry before winter.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The most important clue of Act 1.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Someone is alive below.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The pantry ledger shows meals sent down to the lower levels — long after the Queen supposedly left. Someone down there is being fed.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Fountain Plaza. Villain pushes back.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The fountain hasn't run in months.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Environmental clue.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Sets up the flood sabotage in Area 19.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The water runs black. Something is blocking the pipes further down — where no pipes should be.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Bath House. Allies gathered.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Get the water out of the lower castle.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The way down is found.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Now it just has to be opened.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Draining the baths reveals an old service shaft, bricked up recently — the mortar is still soft.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Sealed Dungeon.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Get her out.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Rescue cutscene, reunion, then the sting: Grimm escapes.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Freya becomes co-lead from Area 26 on.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Freya is alive. Thin, furious, and holding a stack of evidence she has been building for eleven weeks. Grimm is already riding out the north gate.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Where is Queen Freya?

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Freya found alive in the sealed dungeon. Grimm flees the castle.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Leo returns from the royal hunt to a rotted castle and a missing wife.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Grimm says she left.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Every room Leo rebuilds says otherwise.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: It does not end here.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Blacksmith's Forge. Setup.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Get a fire lit in the forge. Nothing gets rebuilt without a smith.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Smith joins the cast.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Gruff, ashamed, useful.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: He kept one of the old keys back out of spite.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The smith was ordered to melt down the old castle keys — all of them — and cast new ones to a pattern he was given.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Harbour. First hard evidence.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The harbour is silting up and trade has stopped.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Second independent source pointing at the same place.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The player should now be ahead of Leo, and impatient.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The harbourmaster's book records the barge. Under owner it says only: the house on the ridge.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Weaver's Hall. Villain pushes back.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The weavers have no wool and no wages.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The timeline breaks.

lines.speaker: Grimm
lines.text: Grimm did not seize an opportunity —

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: he was given a date.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Vane livery was woven here, in quantity, months before Leo rode out on the hunt. This was planned long in advance.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Toll Gate. Allies gathered.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Reopen the toll gate so the road north is legally passable.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The paperwork of a kidnapping.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Bureaucratic, banal, damning.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The toll ledger shows a single carriage passing north eleven weeks ago, at night, exempt from toll by order of House Vane.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Harvest Court.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Hold the Harvest Court. Make the whole kingdom watch.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Public, loud, satisfying —

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: then the floor drops out.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Vane is the answer to Arc 2 and the question for Arc 3.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Big spectacle area; the whole village is present.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Before the assembled kingdom, Freya reads the agreement aloud. Lord Aldric Vane is stripped and taken. He laughs, and says Grimm was never working for him — he was working for someone else.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Who helped Grimm? He could not have done this alone.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The traitor inside the court is named and exposed at the Harvest Court.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Grimm is gone but not alone.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Someone opened doors for him.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Leo and Freya rebuild the ruined village outside the walls, and every grateful villager remembers a face that shouldn't have been there.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: It does not end here.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Assay Room. Setup.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The assayer will not speak. Give him his workshop back.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: ARC BEAT.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The question sharpens: not *where did the gold go* but *what is the fake coin buying?* Assayer joins the cast, terrified of what he certified.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The assayer tested the new coin himself. It is debased — a third silver, two thirds tin. Somebody has been paying wages in false money.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Trade Road North. First hard evidence.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The north road is impassable and the caravans have stopped.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Infrastructure built for war, paid for as maintenance.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The kingdom funded its own siege.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The road was widened this year — quietly, at crown expense — to take wagons far heavier than any trade cart.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Smelter. Villain pushes back.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The smelter is cold and the ore is stacked outside.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: ARC BEAT.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The gold's destination is finally concrete.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Iron, not treasure.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The arc's question is answered but the answer is worse.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The smelter has not been making coin. It has been making weapons — and the moulds are still warm.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The River Crossing. Allies gathered.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Reopen the crossing. Everything beyond it is out of the crown's hands.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: ARC BEAT.

lines.speaker: Grimm
lines.text: Grimm has a handler.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The arc's real answer starts here —

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: and it belongs to Arc 4.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The ferryman has carried Grimm across four times this year. Each time, Grimm was met on the far bank by a rider in colours Leo does not recognise.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Ledger Room.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Put the whole account together, in one room, on one table.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: No spectacle, no crowd.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Two people and a table, working it out.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The horror is arithmetic.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Ends by pointing straight at Arc 4.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The whole scheme laid out end to end: the kingdom's gold traded abroad, an army bought with it, and Grimm signing for all of it on behalf of a crown that is not Leo's. Freya names the crest. It belongs to the neighbouring kingdom — and its monarch is expected at the border within the month.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The kingdom is broke. Where did the gold go?

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The gold bought an army. Grimm is not hiding — he is arming.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The crown cannot pay its own guards.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Ledgers are clean, which is the problem —

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: they are too clean.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: It does not end here.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Snow Chapel. Setup.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The chapel in the snow is the last shelter before the pass.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: ARC BEAT.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: First voice from inside the enemy.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: He asks for Freya specifically, which nobody can explain yet.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: A monk has been sheltering a deserter from the northern army. The man will talk — for a price, and only to the Queen.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Ice Harbour. First hard evidence.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The ice harbour is where the foreign gold came ashore.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Written proof she was presented at a foreign court against her will —

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: and recorded as willing.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The customs book records Freya's arrival by name, as a guest of the northern crown, eleven weeks ago. Signed for by Grimm.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Winter Ballroom. Villain pushes back.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Attend the winter ball. Refusing would be the same as declaring war.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: ARC BEAT.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The arc's cruellest scene.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Nobody draws a weapon.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Leo has to stand and applaud with everyone else, or start a war in a ballroom.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: The betrothal is announced publicly, to applause: Queen Freya of the south to King Haldor of the north, upon the annulment of an invalid marriage.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Hall of Banners. Allies gathered.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The hall of banners records every treaty the north has ever signed.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: ARC BEAT.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Haldor stops being a rival and becomes a pattern.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The scale of the danger jumps.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Haldor has done this before. Three smaller kingdoms, three arranged marriages, three annulments, three absorptions. Freya is the fourth.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Broken Treaty.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Break the treaty publicly, on Leo's terms, before Haldor can break it on his.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Public vindication, then the ground opens.

lines.speaker: Grimm
lines.text: Grimm is captured and immediately becomes the mystery.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Arc 5 begins with that sentence.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Before both courts, Freya lays out the forgeries and Haldor's own seal. The annulment collapses and the treaty with it. Haldor withdraws — and leaves Grimm behind, disowned, standing alone between two armies. As he is taken, Grimm looks at Leo and says: ask your father's confessor what he did with his second son.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Who is paying Grimm now?

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: A neighbouring crown is revealed as Grimm's patron. War is one insult away.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Banners appear on the northern ridge.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Leo must repair the border forts he let rot and host a peace summit he cannot afford.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Freya negotiates.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: It does not end here.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Bell Tower. Setup.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The bell has not rung since the old king died.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The name arrives in a child's handwriting, in a place adults never look.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Devastating and quiet.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Scratched inside the bell chamber, where only a child climbing to hide would put it: a name — Aldous — and beside it, son of the King.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Standing Stones. First hard evidence.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The standing stones mark the boundary of the old estate.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Two sons, one born to a crown and one to a grave marker with no name.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Leo works it out standing there.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: One stone is newer than the rest, and it is a grave marker. No name. The date is the year Leo was born.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Sealed Wing. Villain pushes back.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The sealed wing has been bricked up since Leo was a boy.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: A grief nobody ever processed, preserved in dust.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Leo has not been in these rooms since he was six.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: This wing was closed the week Leo's mother died. Her rooms are exactly as she left them, and her letters are still on the desk.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Hidden Chamber. Allies gathered.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: A chamber behind the crypt wall that appears on no plan.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: ARC BEAT.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: He built a museum of the family that erased him.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Pity and horror in the same object.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Grimm's own archive: every document of his life, kept in order, in a hidden room under a castle he was never allowed to enter.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Old King's Study.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Go back to Leo's father's study and read it as it really is.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The emotional summit of the whole game.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: No spectacle —

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: two brothers and a letter.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Ends by launching the siege of Arc 6.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: In the hidden drawer: the old king's unsent letter, asking his elder son to come home and take what was his. Leo reads it aloud to Grimm in his cell. Grimm does not believe him — and then does, and breaks. Then he tells them what he has already set in motion, and that it is too late to stop: the army is coming, and it is coming for the castle.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Why did Grimm hate Leo from the beginning?

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Grimm is Leo's half-brother. The old king hid him. Grimm never forgave either of them.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: A sealed crypt, a monk who kept a secret for forty years, and a second name in the old king's records.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Leo rebuilds the places his father tried to erase —

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: and finds out the man who buried his wife shares his blood.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: It does not end here.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Powder Store. Setup.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The powder store is under the wall and one spark ends the siege badly.

lines.speaker: Grimm
lines.text: Grimm's contingency, laid before any of this.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The castle has a bomb in its heart.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Someone has already moved half the powder — inward, under the throne room. It was placed months ago.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Shattered Hall. First hard evidence.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The great hall roof is down. Clear it before the next assault.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The proof survives the building.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Paper outlasting stone is the whole theme of the game.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Under the rubble, the Arc 2 evidence chest — the agreement, the ledgers, the forged letters — crushed but readable.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Ruined Bedchamber. Villain pushes back.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The bedchamber has taken a stone from a trebuchet.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Quiet beat in the middle of a siege.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: They sit in the wreck of their bedroom and read it again.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Under the broken floorboard, Freya's note from Area 021, still there. One word: BELOW.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The Surrender Field. Allies gathered.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The field where it stops. Take the surrender and the cost.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Do not skip the bill.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The game has been generous; this area is where it is honest.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Eleven hundred names on both sides. Freya reads all of them aloud. It takes until dark.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Grand Courtyard.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: The Grand Courtyard. Everything, restored, in daylight.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: End on the courtyard from Area 002 in full sun.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The last repair task lights the whole castle at once.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Hold on the wide shot and roll credits.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Leo and Freya are crowned together, by the kingdom's consent rather than by a document. Aldous stands in the crowd, named, pardoned, and not restored — and that is the ending he accepts. The old king's statue is raised again with both his sons' names on the base.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Can the kingdom survive Grimm's last move?

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Grimm defeated. The castle restored to full glory. Leo and Freya crowned together before the whole kingdom.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: Grimm comes back with an army and burns what Leo rebuilt.

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: The last arc is the whole game in reverse —

lines.speaker: Alfred
lines.text: repairing under fire, room by room, until the castle stands and the crown is finally, publicly, undisputed.
